page.title: Channels
page.description: Manage channels for each email platform; configured channels automatically join the sending rotation.
page.emptyDescription: Set up your first email channel to automatically join the sending rotation via /v1/send.

badge.bounceTitle: Bounce rate = bounces / final-state events (threshold adjustable in system settings)

form.name: Channel name
form.priorityHint: Lower value takes precedence (rotation follows ascending priority)
form.mockHintCreate: Leave blank to always succeed; fail = simulate platform 5xx (retry); fail_rate_limit = simulate 429 rate limit (cooldown); fail_auth = simulate 401 auth failure (auto-disable)
form.mockHintEdit: Leave blank to keep the current value; fail = simulate platform 5xx (retry); fail_rate_limit = simulate 429 rate limit (cooldown); fail_auth = simulate 401 auth failure (auto-disable)
form.apiSecretHint: Mailjet secret, used together with the API Key
form.fromEmailHintDefault: Used when the request omits from
form.limitHintDefault: Leave blank to use the platform default
form.rateLimitHint: Set per the platform docs (e.g. Resend ~10/s); sends above the limit queue instead of failing
form.proxyHint: http:// or socks5://, leave blank for direct connection
form.webhookSecretHint: Delivery event webhook signing secret (Resend whsec_… / Mailgun Signing Key); leave blank to verify only via the callback URL token
form.allowedDomainsHint: Comma-separated; leave blank for no restriction
form.blankKeep: Leave blank to keep the current value
form.maskHint: Saved masked; leave blank to keep the current value

validation.name: Enter a channel name
validation.apiKey: This platform requires an API Key
validation.portRange: Port must be an integer between 1 and 65535
validation.smtpFromEmail: SMTP channels require a sender email
validation.nonNegativeInt: Must be an integer no less than 0
validation.invalidSampleVars: Sample variables must be a valid JSON object

testSend.title: Test Send · {{name}}
testSend.toHint: Sends directly through this channel (no rotation); success deducts the channel's daily/monthly quota and records a test log
testSend.templateHint: Replaces the default test subject/body with the rendered template

delete.title: Delete Channel
delete.confirmPrefix: Are you sure you want to delete
delete.warning: This action cannot be undone; existing send logs are unaffected.

detail.title: Channel Details · {{name}}
detail.noRecords: No sends in the last 7 days
detail.noDeliveryData: No final-state event data yet (configure the platform webhook to see delivery/bounce/complaint rates)
detail.webhookTokenMissing: Not generated yet (generated automatically after edit and save)

toast.testSuccess: Channel "{{name}}" test send succeeded in {{latency}} ms
toast.webhookRotated: Event callback URL rotated; update the platform webhook accordingly
